items.title: Where Analysts Pushed Back On NXPI's Latest Call
items.summary: NXP Semiconductors says its auto business is a unique growth story, but on its latest earnings call, analysts kept asking why it looks so different from its peers.

items.title: What Is The Market Really Expecting From AVGO Stock?
items.summary: At $422, Broadcom (AVGO) is being priced to deliver 26% revenue growth annually for the next 5 years simply to defend today's 68.4x multiple. That sits below the 32% the business is currently growing at, which is the unusual part. The multiple has already priced in a slowdown that has not yet appeared.
